title: Bessie Smith and Ethel Waters
summary: Scott heard Bessie and Ethel Waters and liked them best.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: Did you ever hear Bessie Smith?
Did you ever hear Bessie Smith sing?
Yes, yes, I heard Bessie. Bessie and Ethel Waters. That was the ones that I liked the best. Oh, she was great. She was (inaudible) before then. She was great, she could sing anything.
